svg.title: MM-RAG Platform — Current Workflow and DEV Architecture
svg.desc: Phase 5 development workflow showing the accepted asynchronous and governance foundations plus immutable sparse indexing, authorized dense and BM25 retrieval, deterministic hybrid-v3 adaptive selection, pinned local reranking, and the v4 validation result that missed the nDCG gate while withholding holdout and product proof.
